title: Switch OpenClaw to Qwen3 14B and prove real end-to-end tool execution
description: Use the already validated native-tool-capable qwen3:14b model as OpenClaw primary, preserve the previous configuration, avoid restarting the gateway unless a fresh-session tool proof fails, verify a real filesystem side effect through OpenClaw, and automatically restore the previous configuration on failure.
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge';$work='C:/3EN-Agent/workbench';New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $work|Out-Null;$cfg=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.openclaw/openclaw.json';$model='qwen3:14b';$key='ollama/'+$model;$c=Get-Content $cfg -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null -eq $c.agents -or $null -eq $c.agents.defaults -or $null -eq $c.agents.defaults.model){throw '057N_CONFIG_MODEL_STRUCTURE_MISSING'};if(-not ($c.agents.defaults.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'models') -or $null -eq $c.agents.defaults.models){$c.agents.defaults|Add-Member -Force -NotePropertyName models -NotePropertyValue ([pscustomobject]@{})};if(-not ($c.agents.defaults.models.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains $key)){$c.agents.defaults.models|Add-Member -NotePropertyName $key -NotePropertyValue ([pscustomobject]@{})};$oldPrimary=[string]$c.agents.defaults.model.primary;$c.agents.defaults.model.primary=$key;$c|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 50|Set-Content $cfg -Encoding UTF8;$check=Get-Content $cfg -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if([string]$check.agents.defaults.model.primary -ne $key){throw '057N_CONFIG_PRIMARY_WRITE_FAILED'};Write-Output ('V445_057N_PRIMARY_OLD='+$oldPrimary);Write-Output ('V445_057N_PRIMARY_NEW='+$key);$target=Join-Path $work 'openclaw-qwen3-e2e-proof.txt';Remove-Item $target -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;$prompt='Use the write tool to create exactly C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/openclaw-qwen3-e2e-proof.txt containing exactly one line: OPENCLAW_QWEN3_E2E_OK . You must actually invoke the write tool. After the tool succeeds reply exactly OPENCLAW_QWEN3_E2E_DONE.';function Invoke-Proof([string]$session){$raw=@(& openclaw.cmd agent --session-key $session --message $prompt --json --timeout 240 2>&1);$ec=$LASTEXITCODE;Write-Output ('V445_057N_AGENT_SESSION='+$session+' exit='+$ec);foreach($line in $raw){Write-Output ('V445_057N_AGENT_OUTPUT='+[string]$line)};$ok=$false;if($ec -eq 0 -and (Test-Path $target)){try{$txt=(Get-Content $target -Raw).Trim();$ok=($txt -eq 'OPENCLAW_QWEN3_E2E_OK')}catch{$ok=$false}};return $ok};$session1='3en-057n-qwen3-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N');$ok=Invoke-Proof $session1;$restarted=$false;if(-not $ok){Write-Output 'V445_057N_FRESH_SESSION_PROOF=FAIL_RESTART_GATEWAY_ONCE';& openclaw.cmd gateway restart 2>&1|ForEach-Object{Write-Output ('V445_057N_GATEWAY_RESTART='+[string]$_)};if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw ('057N_GATEWAY_RESTART_FAILED_'+$LASTEXITCODE)};Start-Sleep -Seconds 5;Remove-Item $target -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;$session2='3en-057n-qwen3-retry-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N');$ok=Invoke-Proof $session2;$restarted=$true};if(-not $ok){throw '057N_OPENCLAW_QWEN3_E2E_PROOF_FAILED'};$txt=(Get-Content $target -Raw).Trim();if($txt -ne 'OPENCLAW_QWEN3_E2E_OK'){throw ('057N_E2E_CONTENT_MISMATCH actual='+$txt)};[pscustomobject]@{testedAt=(Get-Date).ToString('o');primary=$key;model=$model;target=$target;content=$txt;gatewayRestarted=$restarted;success=$true}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5|Set-Content (Join-Path $root 'v445-qwen3-openclaw-e2e.json') -Encoding UTF8;$model|Set-Content (Join-Path $root 'selected-tool-model.txt') -Encoding ASCII;Write-Output ('V445_057N_OPENCLAW_E2E=PASS model='+$model+' gatewayRestarted='+$restarted+' target='+$target)
